execution_policy: A role operation must first resolve its declared mode and court offices, then bootstrap the bounded virtual-addressed Piston/Ghost live bus, execute one tokenized operator-intelligence NSQ transaction, commit its operation state, and release every lease. No role starts a resident runtime, bypasses a declared feature contract, or claims an unavailable model weight or target boundary.
state_policy: Operation state is written only after the real NSQ transaction completes. A state record is evidence of a completed operation, never a substitute for one.

modes.label: Assistant
modes.purpose: Interpret a user request, preserve visible uncertainty, and execute a bounded NSQ semantic action.

modes.label: Designer
modes.purpose: Transform a stated construction goal into a bounded, verifiable NSQ design action without asserting target materialization that has not occurred.

modes.label: Agent
modes.purpose: Route an on-demand task through declared ingress, verification, and execution lanes while preserving the physical boundary truth.

modes.label: Worker
modes.purpose: Perform one bounded local NSQ task with explicit verification, recovery, and released-address proof.

modes.label: Personal
modes.purpose: Execute a locally initiated owner-directed operation with validation, custody awareness, and no authority transfer beyond the configured owner.
